product_results.description: Embrace the Halloween season with the Crayola Light-Ups Jack-O-Lantern. Inside this kit you'll find 1 Recolorable Light-Ups Jack-O-Lantern, 3 Washable Markers (Green, Slate, and Purple), and 1 Instruction Sheet. It's everything you need for a bewitching, glow-in-the-dark adventure! Draw, scribble, and doodle frightening patterns with the 3 Washable Markers and unleash your inner artist. Whatever Halloween scene you decide to create, your masterpiece will glow proud and bright in one of 3 colors - Orange, Lime Green, or Light Blue. Best of all, with a simple wipe clean using a damp cloth, your canvas becomes fresh and you're ready to start again! This battery-operated pumpkin art adventure comes with a 4-hour timer, perfect for adding that magical, glowing touch to your ghoulish Halloween décor (3 AAA batteries required, not included). Ideal for children aged 4 and up, the Crayola Light-Ups Jack-O-Lantern makes unleashing creativity, fun, and easy, turning each Halloween into a spooky and creative celebration! This product is ACMI Certified.

about_item: LIGHT UPS JACK-O-LANTERN: Features 1 Recolorable Light-Ups Jack-O-Lantern, 3 Washable Markers, and an Instruction Sheet.
DECORATE YOUR PUMPKIN: Draw your design using the Washable Markers, flip the switch to light up your pumpkin, then wipe it clean with a damp cloth to start anew!
ULTRA CLEAN WASHABLE MARKERS: Add splashes of color with one of 3 Ultra Clean Washable Marker colors. These markers wash easily from skin, clothing, and most painted walls.
ERASE & RE-COLOR: The erasable surface multiplies the fun and extends playtime, freeing our little artists to experiment with an endless array of designs.
LIGHT UP PUMPKIN: With a simple flip of the switch, watch as your pumpkin lights up in Orange, Lime Green, or Light Blue! (Battery operated with a 4-hour timer).
DURABLE & SHATTER-RESISTANT: The Light Ups Jack-O-Lantern is made of durable & shatter-resistant material.
HALLOWEEN GIFT FOR KIDS: The Crayola Light-Ups Jack-O-Lantern makes a great Halloween gift for boys and girls ages 4 and up!

summary.text: Customers find the coloring toy enjoyable and appreciate its durability, noting it doesn't break when dropped. They describe it as super cute, with the ability to light up in many different colors.
